blocks.html: Within the Eastern Subarea, the maximum length of a building at any height shall be 400 feet, as measured parallel to the street line. For the purposes of the Section, abutting buildings shall be considered a single building. However, buildings that only abut via an enclosed bridge that is located at least 30 feet above the adjoining grade, and that has a width of not more than 30 feet, length of not more than 60 feet and a height not exceeding 15 feet, shall not be considered a single building.

blocks.html: For any story fully above a height of 125 feet, the following provisions shall apply. Where a building has multiple portions above such height, the maximum size requirements shall apply to each portion separately.
